ProviderSettings._comment_Ollama_BookReview: Whole-book developmental review (wb2). Each per-dimension call sends the ENTIRE budgeted book context ([BOOK_CONTEXT] = BookBrief + many ChapterBriefs) and the model emits a per-chapter dimensionSignals scratch block BEFORE the findings, so BOTH input and output scale with chapter count. WITHOUT this entry AiTaskType.BookReview falls back to NumCtx=4096 (the implicit ProviderTuningOptions default, NOT the Ollama entry's 8192) — on a 15+ chapter book the input alone overflows 4096, Ollama TRUNCATES the prompt, and the model returns a lone '{' so ExtractJson fails and EVERY dimension returns null (job falsely Succeeded with 0 findings). NumCtx=16384 fits a large book's input+output (book budget derives as NumCtx*0.5≈8192 tokens, matching LinguisticAnalysis); NumPredict=6144 gives the dimensionSignals+findings output room to complete on a 20-40 chapter book. Verified live (gemma4:12b, 16-chapter synthetic): default 4096 -> 1-char '{' (6/6 fail); 16384/6144 -> complete valid JSON, findings parse.

FeatureModels._comment_ProofreadModel: KEEP IN SYNC: Proofread:Model is duplicated in ProofreadQualityTests.ProofreadModel (Pagedraft.Api.Tests/LanguageEngine/ProofreadQualityTests.cs). Update both when changing the model.
FeatureModels._comment_ProofreadFallback: DEPLOYMENT RISK: DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B (Proofread) and gemma4:12b (Proofread_en / LinguisticAnalysis) must be pulled on every Ollama host before starting the API. If either model is missing, OllamaProvider's 404-retry-with-default silently falls back to DefaultModel (qwen3.5:9b) with no error surfaced - for Proofread that is the overreaching model this work replaced (precision 13%, known meaning-changing edits). Run: ollama pull hf.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Instruct-GGUF:latest && ollama pull gemma4:12b
FeatureModels._comment_ProofreadCloud: CLOUD MAX-QUALITY = OpenRouter / google/gemma-4-31b-it (Hebrew bake-off subset 2026-06-20: precision 88%, recall 100%, overreach 0/2 (precision gate PASS), ~$0.001; see docs/PROOFREAD_LINEEDIT_CLOUD_BAKEOFF.md). A ~31B model that does NOT fit the 8 GB dev GPU - it is the quality ceiling for FUTURE GPU-server hosting, not the local default. Active value is the best LOCAL model (Ollama/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B) for free/offline/private use. To ship the cloud winner set Provider=OpenRouter, Model=google/gemma-4-31b-it AND update ProofreadQualityTests.ProofreadModel to match; otherwise keep the local model below.
FeatureModels._comment_Proofread_en: English MEASURED 2026-06-21 (proofread-gold-en.json, 30 cases) - gemma4:12b vs qwen3.5:9b: precision 82% vs 31%, recall 69% vs 69% (tied), fp-rate 6% vs 53%, overreach 0/3 vs 1/3, F0.5 0.789 vs 0.349. gemma4:12b validated on the same precision gate as the Hebrew flow - far higher precision/lower overreach at equal recall; cost is ~2.2x latency (4414 vs 2023 ms/case), acceptable for proofread. KEEP gemma4:12b. Cloud gemma-4-31b-it remains the future-GPU upgrade candidate.

Ai._comment_BookReviewSingleCombined: Whole-book review fan-out strategy (wb2-r02). TRUE (default) runs ONE combined LLM call assessing all six dimensions (plot/character/pacing/tone/theme/continuity) over a single assembled book context; FALSE falls back to the per-dimension fan-out (six calls capped by MaxParallelBookReviewDimensions). Default is single-combined because wb2-c04 measured per-dimension (6 calls/book) as a QUALITY TIE with single-combined (1 call/book) - same planted-recall, same 0 clean false positives, identical composite - at 6x the model calls and more noise; wb2-c06 then showed the per-dimension parallel fan-out CRASHES the 8 GB dev GPU on big books while a single combined call completes. Per-dimension is kept reversible behind this toggle ONLY for a future larger-GPU re-measure; set false to use it.
Ai._comment_OllamaParallel: For parallel chunk processing, set env OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=2 (or higher) where Ollama runs; restart Ollama after changing.
Ai._comment_HebrewStyle: House-style toggles for the Hebrew copyedit layer. EnforceKtivMale=true (default) appends deterministic haser->male full-spelling suggestions to Hebrew proofread results; set false for houses that do not normalize to ktiv-male.
